meta_title: Sodalite: Jellyfin for Apple TV, iPhone, iPad and Mac
meta_description: A free, native Jellyfin app for Apple TV, iPhone, iPad and Mac, with Seerr requests built in. Direct Play, Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, lossless height channels, Live TV and music. Open source, no tracking.
hero_text: Sodalite plays your Jellyfin library on Apple TV, iPhone, iPad and Mac. Native, fast, and in the picture and sound quality your files were made in. Request what's missing through Seerr, without leaving the app.
hero_free: Free. One download for all your Apple devices.
hero_beta: Want new versions early? Join the TestFlight beta.
hero_alt: Sodalite Home screen on Apple TV
tour_text: One app with the same library, the same look and the same player, from the TV in the living room to the phone in your hand.
features_title: Everything on your server, and more
features_text: Sodalite talks to your Jellyfin server directly. Here is what you get.
f_home_text: Continue Watching, Next Up, the latest additions, favorites, collections and playlists. Show, hide and reorder every row. Run several servers? Home can combine up to five into one.
f_detail_text: Artwork first, the plot on the first screen, ratings from TMDB, IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes, format badges like 4K, Dolby Vision and Atmos, the cast with full filmographies, and every version of a title to choose from.
f_player_title: A player made for the remote
f_player_text: Frame-exact previews while you scrub, Skip Intro and Skip Recap, the next episode with a countdown, fast forward up to 256x, Picture in Picture, and subtitles in every format, including styled ASS and Blu-ray PGS. Search and download missing subtitles, or show two at once.
f_live_text: A real program guide with favorites and categories. Pause and rewind live TV, switch channels with the remote, record a show or a whole series, and watch recordings while they are still running.
f_multiview_text: Watch up to four live channels at once on Apple TV. The sound follows the tile you select, a click makes it full screen.
f_request_text: Browse trending and upcoming movies and shows through Seerr. Request a movie, a whole series or single seasons, follow the status, and approve requests if you are an admin. One sign-in for both.
f_music_text: Browse your Jellyfin music by album and play it with a proper Now Playing screen, cover art, scrubbing and playback in the background.
f_go_text: On iPhone and iPad: download movies and whole seasons to watch offline, send a title to a TV with AirPlay, or connect an HDMI adapter. Rotation lock and a child lock sit right in the player.
f_mac_text: A real Mac app, not a port: a sidebar, the player in its own window, full keyboard control, full screen and right-click menus.
f_trakt_text: Connect Trakt with a code. What you watch is scrobbled, watched status and ratings sync both ways, and your watchlist and lists become Home rows. No server plugin needed.
yours_text: Sodalite has a setting for almost everything, and each profile keeps its own.
y_look_text: Pick an accent color and a Graphite Glass or OLED Black background. Choose card sizes, artwork style, title logos and which badges you want to see.
y_nav_text: On Apple TV, navigate from the bar at the top or from a sidebar in your accent color. Choose which tabs appear, and pin a library like Movies as a tab of its own.
y_home_text: Turn rows on and off, put them in your order, and add Recently Released, Upcoming episodes, your favorite episodes or a Latest row per library.
y_player_text: Hide the player buttons you never use and put the rest in your order. Set the skip interval for each direction, and switch on Stats for Nerds when you want the details.
y_audio_text: Dialogue Boost makes voices clearer, Night Mode keeps loud scenes down at night, and a speaker setting folds surround to stereo or 5.1.
y_subs_text: Font, size, position and style. Forced subtitles show on their own, and your track choice is remembered for each film and series.
y_profiles_text: Switch profiles without a password, each with its own settings. A Guardian PIN locks profiles and settings, and spoiler protection blurs episodes you have not seen yet.
y_sync_text: Servers, sign-ins and settings follow you to every device on your iCloud account, end-to-end encrypted.
engine_title: Picture and sound, as they were mastered.
engine_text: Underneath Sodalite runs AetherEngine, our own open source video engine. It plays your files as they are, so your server does not have to convert them, and it keeps what other apps throw away.
e_direct_text: HEVC, H.264, AV1, VP9, MPEG-2, VC-1 and old DivX and WMV files, in MKV, MP4, AVI, TS and more, even DVD and Blu-ray folders. Played directly, without transcoding on your server.
e_hdr_text: HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision and HLG, with the full metadata. Apple TV switches your TV to the matching mode on its own, and Enhanced Upscaling sharpens SD and 720p video.
e_dv7_text: Blu-ray remuxes with Dolby Vision Profile 7, FEL included, are converted on the device to Profile 8.1, so your TV still shows Dolby Vision. For FEL, the brightness of the enhancement layer is folded in scene by scene, which brings the picture much closer to the disc.
e_atmos_text: Dolby Atmos from Dolby Digital Plus tracks lights up the Atmos sign on your receiver, and plays as Spatial Audio on AirPods.
e_height_text: Apple TV cannot pass TrueHD or DTS:X on to your receiver, so their height channels usually get lost. AetherEngine keeps them: it renders the track into a 9.1.6 mix and sends it to your receiver over HDMI without lossy compression.
e_subs_text: Text and image subtitles are drawn on the device: SRT, styled ASS, WebVTT, Blu-ray PGS, DVD, DVB and Teletext. Your server does not have to burn them in.
platforms_text: One free download covers all four. Your servers and settings sync between them through iCloud.
req_tv: Apple TV 4K with tvOS 26 or later
req_server: You need a Jellyfin server. Seerr is optional.
community_title: Open source, and built in the open
community_text: Sodalite is free and its source code is public on GitHub. No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your sign-ins stay on your devices and in your own iCloud.
c_bug_title: Found a bug or missing a feature?
c_bug_text: Tell us on GitHub. Every report is read, and many features in Sodalite started as a request.
c_bug_button: Report a bug or request a feature
c_chat_text: Join the Discord for quick questions, tips and release news.
c_source_text: Sodalite is GPL-3.0, AetherEngine is LGPL-3.0. Study it, build it yourself, or help make it better.
final_text: Get Sodalite for free on the App Store.
